items.title: Smart Girl Cleaning Services launches
items.description: Started from one small room in Ilorin, with four children and no business manual.

items.title: 150 elderly women fed across three Ilorin markets
items.description: Food taken to elderly women at Ipata, Mandate and Ago markets. Every bag carried the same message: Smart Girl cleaned. Someone got fed.
